summary:
[  edit  ]
The Leap Motion  CHOP  reads hand, finger, tool and gesture data from the  Leap Motion  controller. It outputs hand, finger and tool positions, rotations and 'tracking' channels that indicate if these values are currently being detected and updated. Currently only 1 Leap Motion device can be connected at a time.
To connect with the device you will need to install the Ultraleap Tracking Software. For best performance, it is recommended to use the latest version Gemini drivers for Windows (v5.13.2 or greater) or MacOS (v5.14.0 or greater) that are available here:  https://developer.leapmotion.com/tracking-software-download . Legacy version 2 or version 4 Orion drivers are also supported. See the API parameter details below for more information.
In addition to installing the driver, TouchDesigner must also be told where to find the tracking library. Installation instructions vary depending on the operating system:
On Windows:  You can use the Library  Folder  parameter to point to the location of the LeapC.dll (Orion/Gemini) or Leap.dll (Version 2/3) files on your system. The file is installed as part of the LeapSDK and the location may vary depending on the version and options selected during installation.
On MacOS:  The library folder should point to the location of the Ultraleap tracking app. By default this is '/Applications/Ultraleap Hand Tracking.app' TouchDesigner will automatically find the library files inside the application's contents folder.
Tip:  If using Gemini V5, the Leap Motion will only work in one orientation. By default the hands enter from the bottom of the camera view, though this can be changed in setting to invert the direction. This is an important distinction between Gemini V5 and the older V2/V4 APIs which could work in either orientation.
Note:  TouchDesigner does not include a license to use the Leap Motion hardware or software. Make sure to check with the  UltraLeap website  regarding any applicable licenses that you may need for your project.
See also  Leap Motion ,  Leap Motion TOP

parameters.label: Active
parameters.name: active
parameters.description: When 'On' data is captured from the Leap Motion sensor.

parameters.label: API
parameters.name: api
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select between Leap Motion V2 or V4/V5 SDKs for tracking. V5 offers the fastest and most stable tracking, V2 offers some legacy features like gestures.

parameters.label: Version 2 Tracking
parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Legacy tracking that includes gesture and tool tracking. Download  (Windows: Orion Beta 3.2.1, MacOS: 2.3.1)

parameters.label: Orion (v4) / Gemini (v5)
parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Gemini offers the best performance with improved stability and faster hand recognition to start tracking. Download  Gemini (Windows 5.13.2 or greater, MacOS 5.14 or greater)  . Legacy version 4 Orion tracking is available on Windows only. Download  Orion 4.1.0 .

parameters.label: Library  Folder
parameters.name: libfolder
parameters.description: This parameter is used on Windows only to point to the location of the library file (.dll) that corresponds to the selected API version. The dll file can be found in the driver kit downloaded from the Ultraleap website inside the 'LeapSDK/lib/x64' folder. For V4 and V5 the file is called 'LeapC.dll', for version 2 it is called 'Leap.dll'.

parameters.label: HMD Mode
parameters.name: hmd
parameters.description: ⊞  - Switches the device to  H ead  M ounted  D isplay mode.

parameters.label: Debug Channels
parameters.name: debugchannels
parameters.description: If set, the following channels will be included:

parameters.label: connected
parameters.description: 1 if the Leap Motion sensor is connected, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: sequence_id
parameters.description: Unique id corresponding to the current frame.

parameters.label: Status Channels
parameters.name: statuschannels
parameters.description: If set, the following channels will be included:

parameters.label: hands
parameters.description: Number of hands detected by the sensor.

parameters.label: fingers
parameters.description: Number of fingers detected by the sensor.

parameters.label: tools
parameters.description: Number of tools detected by the sensor.

parameters.label: gestures
parameters.description: Number of gestures detected by the sensor.

parameters.label: [hand / finger / tool / circle / swipe / keytap / screeptap]:tracking
parameters.description: 1 if the data for the hand, finger, tool or gesture is actively being tracked, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: Named Hands
parameters.name: namedhands
parameters.description: This names the hand channels as either right (r) or left (l) hands.

parameters.label: Hands
parameters.name: hands
parameters.description: Number of hands. The following channels will be included for each detected hand:

parameters.label: hand*:t[xyz]
parameters.description: Coordinates of the hand relative to the sensor.

parameters.label: hand*:r[xyz]
parameters.description: Rotation of the detected hand.

parameters.label: Left Hands
parameters.name: lefthands
parameters.description: When using 'Named Hands', specify how many left hands will be tracked.

parameters.label: Right Hands
parameters.name: righthands
parameters.description: When using 'Named Hands', specify how many right hands will be tracked.

parameters.label: Hand Velocity
parameters.name: handvelocity
parameters.description: If set, the following channels will be included for each hand, in addition to any others:

parameters.label: hand*:v[xyz]
parameters.description: Velocity of the detected hand.

parameters.label: Hand Sphere
parameters.name: handsphere
parameters.description: This is only available when using API = Version 2 Tracking. It adds the following channels to tracking hands:

parameters.label: hand*/sphere:t[xyz]
parameters.description: Position of the detected hand sphere.

parameters.label: hand*/sphere:radius
parameters.description: Radius size of the detected hand sphere.

parameters.label: Pinch Strength
parameters.name: pinchstrength
parameters.description: Pinch is defined as the distance between the thumb and first finger.

parameters.label: hand*:pinch
parameters.description: How much pinch is detected between the thumb and first finger.

parameters.label: Grab Strength
parameters.name: grabstrength
parameters.description: Grab is defined as how close a hand is to being a fist.

parameters.label: hand*:grab
parameters.description: How much grab is detected, strength is 0 for a flat hand and 1 for a fist.

parameters.label: Named Fingers
parameters.name: namedfingers
parameters.description: Instead of simply using a finger index number for each finger tracked, when On this names the finger channels as thumb, index, middle, ring, and pinky.

parameters.label: Fingers per Hand
parameters.name: fingersperhand
parameters.description: When not using 'Named Fingers', specify how many fingers to track per hand.

parameters.label: Finger Rotation
parameters.name: fingerrotation
parameters.description: Track the rotation for all fingers.

parameters.label: hand*/finger*:r[xyz]
parameters.description: The rotation of the finger.

parameters.label: Finger Size
parameters.name: fingersize
parameters.description: If set, the following channels will be included for each finger, in addition to any others:

parameters.label: hand*/finger*:length
parameters.description: Length of the detected finger.

parameters.label: hand*/finger*:width
parameters.description: Width of the detected finger.

parameters.label: Finger Extended
parameters.name: fingerextended
parameters.description: Track how straight the fingers are, a finger is considered extended when it is straight as if pointing.

parameters.label: hand*/finger*:extended
parameters.description: How straight the finger is.

parameters.label: Finger Joints
parameters.name: fingerjoints
parameters.description: Tracks the position of every joint of every finger.

parameters.label: hand*/finger*/joint_mcp:t[xyz]
parameters.description: The mcp joint position of the finger.

parameters.label: hand*/finger*/joint_pip:t[xyz]
parameters.description: The pip joint position of the finger.

parameters.label: hand*/finger*/joint_dip:t[xyz]
parameters.description: The dip joint position of the finger.

parameters.label: hand*/finger*/joint_tip:t[xyz]
parameters.description: The finger tip position.

parameters.label: Tools
parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: Number of tools. The following channels will be included for each detected tool:

parameters.label: tool*:t[xyz]
parameters.description: Coordinates of the tool relative to the sensor.

parameters.label: tool*:length
parameters.description: Length of the detected tool.

parameters.label: tool*:width
parameters.description: Width of the detected tool.

parameters.label: Circle Gestures
parameters.name: circlegestures
parameters.description: Number of circle gestures. The following channels will be included for each detected  Circle Gesture :

parameters.label: circle*:handindex
parameters.description: Index of the hand associated with the gesture. See Notes.

parameters.label: circle*:t[xyz]
parameters.description: Coordinates of the center of the Circle Gesture relative to the sensor.

parameters.label: circle*:radius
parameters.description: Radius of the circle in the gesture.

parameters.label: circle*:progress
parameters.description: Number of cycles done in the gesture.

parameters.label: Swipe Gestures
parameters.name: swipegestures
parameters.description: Number of swipe gestures. The following channels will be included for each detected  Swipe Gesture :

parameters.label: swipe*:handindex
parameters.description: Index of the hand associated with the gesture. See Notes.

parameters.label: swipe*:fingerindex
parameters.description: Index of the finger associated with the gesture. See Notes.

parameters.label: swipe*:t[xyz]
parameters.description: Coordinates of the Swipe Gesture relative to the sensor.

parameters.label: swipe*:start[xyz]
parameters.description: Coordinates of the start of the Swipe Gesture relative to the sensor.

parameters.label: swipe*:speed
parameters.description: Speed of the swipe.

parameters.label: Key Tap Gestures
parameters.name: keytapgestures
parameters.description: Number of key tap gestures. The following channels will be included for each detected  Key Tap Gesture :

parameters.label: keytap*:handindex
parameters.description: Index of the hand associated with the gesture. See Notes.

parameters.label: keytap*:fingerindex
parameters.description: Index of the finger associated with the gesture. See Notes.

parameters.label: keytap*:t[xyz]
parameters.description: Coordinates of the Key Tap Gesture relative to the sensor.

parameters.label: Screen Tap Gestures
parameters.name: screentapgestures
parameters.description: Number of screen tap gestures, which is recognized as a quick forward tapping movement by a tool or finger. The following channels will be included for each detected screen tap gesture:

parameters.label: screentap*:handindex
parameters.description: Index of the hand associated with the gesture. See Notes.

parameters.label: screentap*:fingerindex
parameters.description: Index of the finger associated with the gesture. See Notes.

parameters.label: screentap*:t[xyz]
parameters.description: Coordinates of the Screen Tap Gesture relative to the sensor.

parameters.label: For gestures, if  handindex  is 1, then channels with the prefix  hand1  contain the data for the hand associated with the gesture. If  handindex
parameters.name: is
parameters.description: 1 it means there are no channels available for the hand associated with the gesture. The same follows for  fingerindex .

parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope
parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: To determine which channels get affected, some CHOPs use a  Scope  string on the Common page.

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Match
parameters.name: srselect
parameters.description: ⊞  - Handle cases where multiple input CHOPs' sample rates are different. When Resampling occurs, the curves are interpolated according to the Interpolation Method Option, or "Linear" if the Interpolate Options are not available.

parameters.label: Resample At First Input's Rate
parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Use rate of first input to resample others.

parameters.label: Resample At Maximum Rate
parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Resample to the highest sample rate.

parameters.label: Resample At Minimum Rate
parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Resample to the lowest sample rate.

parameters.label: Error If Rates Differ
parameters.name: err
parameters.description: Doesn't accept conflicting sample rates.

parameters.label: Export  Method
parameters.name: exportmethod
parameters.description: ⊞  - This will determine how to connect the  CHOP  channel to the parameter. Refer to the  Export  article for more information.

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Index
parameters.name: datindex
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the index of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Name
parameters.name: datname
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the name of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: Channel Name is  Path : Parameter
parameters.name: autoname
parameters.description: The channel is the full destination of where to export to, such has  geo1/transform1:tx .

parameters.label: Export   Root
parameters.name: autoexportroot
parameters.description: This path points to the root node where all of the paths that exporting by  Channel Name is  Path : Parameter   are relative to.

parameters.label: Export  Table
parameters.name: exporttable
parameters.description: The  DAT  used to hold the export information when using the  DAT  Table  Export  Methods (See above).

parameters.label: start
parameters.description: Start of the  CHOP  interval in samples.

parameters.label: length
parameters.description: Number of samples in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: sample_rate
parameters.description: The samplerate of the channels in frames per second.

parameters.label: num_channels
parameters.description: Number of channels in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: time_slice
parameters.description: 1 if  CHOP  is  Time Slice  enabled, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: export_sernum
parameters.description: A count of how often the export connections have been updated.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: samples
parameters.description: per-second of a  CHOP . Each CHOP in your network has a sample rate. In contrast, the overall timeline has a  Frame Rate , which is the number of frames to  cook  and display per second, generally your monitor display frequency, default 60.

parameters.label: An  Operator Family  that manipulates text strings: multi
parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.

parameters.label: TouchDesigner is a hierarchy of components. "root" is the top
parameters.description: most network in the hierarchy. The  Network Path  or Path for root is simply  / . A typical path is  /project1/moviein1 .
